text:
Comparing a ready flat with an under-construction one? The quoted price hides up to ₹19 lakh of difference on a ₹1 crore home.

On a new ₹1 crore flat in Delhi: stamp duty 6% in a man's name (4% for a woman, 5% jointly), registration 1%, GST 5% while under construction, parking often ₹1 to 5 lakh, brokerage 1 to 2%.
A ready flat with an occupancy certificate pays no GST, which narrows the gap between the two.
Total outlay: ₹1.14 to 1.19 crore before the advance maintenance deposit.

Sources: HomeFirst, Ujjivan SFB, Brigade Group, Square Yards, ICICI Bank (2025 to 2026). Educational, not advice.
